verificationNotes: Repeated synthetic account-creation runs hit the existing registration throttle; the local server was restarted between suites without weakening the limiter.
A mobile preview refresh during a code change interrupted an early test run; the complete suite passed against the final stable source.
Screenshots capture synthetic data; native secure storage/biometrics/photo picking are harness substitutes.
limitations: No physical iOS/Android device or signed app binary validation.
No external EHR, LIS/PACS, pharmacy delivery, billing, insurer or calendar integration.
Notifications are generic in-app notices, not OS push, SMS, email or background delivery.
No inpatient bed-management/billing subsystem or department-specific case-sheet template builder.
Separate photo browser suite was not rerun; four backend photo regression tests passed in the H2 suite.
No fresh production deployment, disaster restore or real patient certification in this revision.
